Perform an evidence-led, read-only audit of this repository. Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

1. Inspect Git state and repository structure.
2. Identify product purpose, supported stacks/platforms, architecture, data flows, external dependencies, deployment model, and project commands from actual files.
3. Map key user/system journeys and trust boundaries.
4. Review security, privacy, accessibility, quality, performance, reliability, maintainability, operations, and supply-chain risks proportionate to the project.
5. Separate confirmed defects, plausible risks, unknowns, and recommendations.
6. Cite file paths/symbols and include exact commands/results only if executed.

Return an executive summary, architecture map, findings ranked by impact/confidence, evidence, verification gaps, and a prioritized roadmap. Do not modify files unless implementation is separately requested.
